NFCI below zero indicates looser-than-average broad financial conditions. These are dated observations, not live market quotes.

Fed & Policy Watch
  • Governor Christopher J. Waller is scheduled at 3:45 AM ET today. The Board's calendar also lists Vice Chair for Supervision Michelle Bowman at 5:40 AM Wednesday and a 10:55 PM Wednesday speech.
  • Beige Book is listed Wednesday, Oct 14. The Board calendar gives 2:00 PM ET, while the Chicago Fed dated calendar lists Beige Book at 3:00 PM ET; this timing conflict is flagged for confirmation.
  • The Board calendar confirms today's holiday-shifted Commercial Paper (1:00 PM) and H.10/H.15 (4:15 PM) releases. H.4.1 is scheduled Thursday at 4:30 PM ET; G.17 Industrial Production is Friday at 9:15 AM ET.
  • Thursday's 8:30 AM cluster: Census retail sales, Chicago Fed NFCI, and the Philadelphia Fed survey. EIA's petroleum report is shifted to noon Thursday after the Columbus Day schedule.
  • SIFMA lists Columbus Day, Oct 12, as a U.S. fixed-income market holiday. The latest official Treasury curve available here is Friday's 5.24% 10Y close.
Omissions and Watch
  • BLS was excluded by operator decision dated Oct 11, 2026; no BLS site or mirror was requested. BLS releases, including CPI, PPI, and import/export prices, are not verified or shown.
  • BEA's checked schedule shows no release dated Oct 13-20; its next listed release is GDP on Oct 29. NY Fed Empire State survey is listed for Oct 15 but says it is released "at or shortly after 8:30"; no exact time is verified, so it is omitted. EIA natural-gas schedule did not give a date-specific Oct 15 event/time, so none is inferred.
  • Beige Book time discrepancy remains between the Board's 2:00 PM and Chicago Fed's 3:00 PM ET calendar entries; the calendar row uses the Board's own date/time while preserving the conflict note.
  • TreasuryDirect lists upcoming auction dates but not cutoff times or offering amounts for the future auctions shown; these rows are explicitly date-only. The three bill cutoffs today have confirmed times and amounts.
  • Primary checks: Federal Reserve Board and Fed releases, NY Fed SOFR/Empire State, Chicago Fed NFCI/release calendar, Census, BEA, TreasuryDirect, U.S. Treasury, EIA petroleum/natural gas, Philadelphia Fed, NAR, and SIFMA. Selected events only; no verified unscheduled policy or geopolitical watch item from this run, which is not a claim that no such risk exists.
  • Yahoo snapshot quotes are single-source. Generic futures quotes are not official settlements; verify current contract, hours, depth, and live prices before execution.
Trading Strategy Note | ES Futures
BASE CASE
Treat the 00:59 ET ES=F quote as overnight context, not a cash-session confirmation. MOVE is moderate and the latest official 10Y close is 5.24%, with the Treasury observation lagging the Columbus Day bond-market holiday. Respect today's housing data and bill supply; Wednesday's Beige Book timing is disputed, and Thursday's 8:30 AM releases plus the noon EIA report are key verified catalysts. Scenario framework only, not a trade signal.
INVALIDATION
Reassess if ES sustains a range break with confirmation from live Treasury yields, volatility, and market depth, or if the applicable contract's trading hours differ. No unsupported levels or price targets are supplied; reconfirm live quotes before execution.
